title: Chiffon Puff Sleeve A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Float through the night in this enchanting chiffon evening dress! Featuring dreamy puff sleeves and a flattering A-line silhouette, this gown exudes timeless elegance. Perfect for formal occasions, it's designed to make you feel effortlessly graceful and stunning.

 

Size Tips: Prioritize selection based on chest measurement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Puff sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
